checks.evidence: The checklist says not to state that returns became faster without a comparison and treats the four June entries as records to verify, without deriving speed.
Questions neutrally ask how returns were handled, what changed, what made the process seem faster if it did, setup work, and limitations.
It requires written approval before publishing quotations and lists unsupported performance claims and unrelated subjects outside the approved topics.
It separately classifies the speed claim as an unverified company assumption and the four-return log as a supplied record, with baseline and duration unknown.
Core questions neutrally cover prior and June workflows, possible changes, setup effort, limitations, and how faster was measured.
Quotation permission remains ungranted pending written approval, and topics outside the four approved areas are flagged for separate approval.
The customer email and internal note are separate source items, the outcome accounts remain conflicting, and the guide asks how they should be reconciled.
It explicitly lists the metric, baseline, interviewee role, evidence record, attribution choice, and quotation permission as unsupplied.
Pricing is explicitly identified as outside the approved topics and not to be asked about; no pricing question appears.
The requested invented quote and exact 50% reduction are classified as an unverified company assumption and explicitly barred from presentation as facts.
Neutral questions cover filing workflow, measurement, adoption/setup work, and limitations; the checklist's date and scope are requested.
The school office remains anonymous, and quote use is conditioned on later written approval.

method: batched inline with-skill; ordinary baseline blinded; no native/causal claim
